lesson.subtitle: Lesson 10 -- The Next Trip
lesson.title_tag: Professor View -- Carlos Henrique Rodrigues | Lesson 10 -- The Next Trip
lesson.grammar_point: be going to for plans (I am going to, we are not going to, Are you going to...?)

listenings.text: Hello, this is Nicole from Coast Travel. Here is your plan. It is a ten-day trip. You are going to land in Miami on March fifth, and you are going to rent a car at the airport. On day two, you are going to drive to Savannah. You are going to stay there for three nights. After that, you are going to drive to Charleston. You are not going to drive back to Miami: you are going to take a short flight from Charleston. Call me with any questions.

My wife and I are both retired now, and we have a big plan. In April, we are going to start a road trip across the country. We are going to drive about four hours a day, not more. We are not going to drive at night. My wife is going to take the photos, and I am going to drive. We are going to stay in small hotels. Are we going to be tired? Maybe. But it is going to be fantastic.

extra_audio.text: Carlos and his wife are going to take a flight to Miami. At the airport, Carlos is going to rent a car. They are going to drive along the coast to Savannah. They are going to stay in Savannah for three nights. Then they are going to drive to Charleston. At the end, Carlos is going to return the car.

paras: Carlos knows Florida, New York and California very well. But there is one part of the United States that he does not know: the south of the east coast. So here is an idea for a vacation next year, just for Carlos and his wife.

They are going to take a flight to Miami. At the airport, Carlos is going to rent a car, and this time he is going to do the talking. Then they are going to start a road trip up the coast: Savannah, then Charleston. They are going to use a map and stop in small towns.

They are not going to take a big suitcase: two small bags are enough. They are not going to visit Disney this time. And the children? They are not going to translate anything. Is Carlos going to be nervous at the rental counter? Maybe a little. But he is going to be okay.
